activity_log.description: Browse/session page events (search/detail/complete), not registration forms. Paths are short browse paths like /detail, /search_list, /input, /confirm — there is no /regist/* here; use form_log for /regist/input and /regist/confirm. Paths such as /detail and /detail/ are distinct values; do not strip trailing slashes unless the question asks to normalize them. Multiple rows can share the same session and stamp (same timestamp, different path/search_type). When selecting the first matching event in a session, pick exactly one row with a deterministic tie-break (ORDER BY stamp, path, search_type).

mst_users.description: User master data. There is no age column — derive age from birth_date relative to a dataset reference date (activity_log timestamps are around 2017-01-09), not date('now'). user_id is not unique (rows are duplicated); when counting users use COUNT(DISTINCT user_id).
